title: Toolbar actions
description: Topbar action group rendering left/right anchor buttons. Bridges legacy command/app shapes via COMMAND_HREFS.

documentation.purpose: Toolbar layout: two horizontal IconButton clusters separated by a `flex: 1` spacer. Renders nothing if both `left` + `right` arrays are empty. Each action is either `{ href, icon, label, external? }` (link) or `{ command, icon, label }` (built-in command resolved via `COMMAND_HREFS` map). IconButton uses `render={<a href>}` so middle-click + right-click → Copy link work natively.

reads.purpose: Authored action descriptors — declared inline in admin.json and passed as React props by mountApp. Each is `{ href|command, icon|iconSource, label, external? }`.

Dynamic +New (#129): enumerate creatable post types via `getPostTypes({ context: 'edit' })`, gated per-type on `canUser('create', { kind: 'postType', name })`. Builds `#/{rest_base}/new` dropdown items.

Admin-bar harvest (#128): plugin admin-bar nodes harvested server-side by WP_Admin_Workspaces_Chrome_Harvest (core nodes the shell owns are skipped). Top-level nodes render as buttons; nodes with children render as dropdowns. Titles are arbitrary admin HTML.

states.when: No authored actions, no creatable post types, and no harvested admin-bar nodes
At least one source has content
states.renders: Row layout — left cluster (+New dropdown + left actions) + spacer + right cluster (right actions + harvested admin-bar nodes).

interactions.effect: Native anchor navigation. External actions open in new tab.
Native browser behavior — opens in new tab. Works because IconButton renders as `<a>`.
Menu of creatable post types; each item navigates to `#/{rest_base}/new`.

interactions.trigger: Open a harvested admin-bar node with children
interactions.effect: Dropdown of the node's child links.

a11y.focus-management: Native anchor focus order; dropdowns use `@wordpress/components` DropdownMenu focus handling.
a11y.screen-reader: IconButton's `label` prop doubles as the assistive-tech label and the tooltip. Harvested nodes derive their `aria-label` from the node's `meta.title` tooltip or the stripped-tags title.

constraints.note: `COMMAND_HREFS` translates legacy `command` ids (`core/new-post`, `core/new-page`) to hash URLs. Adding more requires updating the table.
Render-prop swap is required: `<IconButton render={<a href target rel/>}/>`. The plain `href` prop is dropped by Base UI Button.

Authored actions resolve to URLs. There's no `onClick`-only callback action — keep dispatching to `core:command-palette` or a separate app. Harvested admin-bar onclick-handler nodes degrade to links / disabled items (handler strings are dropped server-side).

An action's `iconSource` (or a harvested node title) bypasses the name-based `resolveIcon` registry: it renders through the engine/app-space `ArbitraryIcon` / `TrustedNodeTitle` pass-through (`` / trusted HTML). The kernel icon registry stays name-based + DS-neutral (#127/#128). See docs/runtime-harvest-pattern.md.
+New builds `#/{rest_base}/new`. A CPT whose shell list-screen path differs from its `rest_base` produces a mismatched link — keep them in sync.

`window.wpAdminWorkspaces.adminBar` node titles are admin-context HTML (same trust as classic wp-admin), rendered unchanged via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. The shell only renders them inside the already-admin-gated workspace.

WP-admin's unlayered `a { color: var(--wp-admin-theme-color) }` wins against `@wordpress/ui` IconButton's layered color. The bundled `core:default` engine ships `.wp-admin-workspaces-region--toolbar a { color: var(--wpds-color-fg-interactive-neutral) }` (+ `:hover/:focus/:active` variants). A non-WPDS engine MUST emit an equivalent unlayered rule for its toolbar scheme.
`@wordpress/icons` SVGs lack `fill`. The bundled `core:default` engine forces `.wp-admin-workspaces-region--toolbar svg { fill: currentColor }`. A non-WPDS engine MUST do the same.

design-system-leakage.purpose: Arbitrary-icon escape hatch for harvested icons / node titles (#127/#128).
